title: DST-Net: Decomposed Spatio-Temporal Network for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.21123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Series decomposition has emerged as a widely acknowledged paradigm in deep time series forecasting models. However, existing approaches predominantly employ a homogeneous modeling strategy for all subsequences, thereby overlooking the distinct inductive biases inherent in different components. We identify that the trend component exhibits dominant spatial coupling across channels but carries significant temporal redundancy, whereas the seasonal component is characterized by local temporal evolution but remains susceptible to attention distraction. To address this, we propose a novel disentangled architecture that tailors specific modeling strategies to align with the intrinsic properties of each component. For the trend branch, we design a Latent Graph Block, employing latent graph modeling to capture global topological dependencies and system-wide co-movements. translated_title: DST-Net：用于时间序列预测的分解时空网络
translated_abstract: 序列分解已成为深度时间序列预测模型中广受认可的范式。然而，现有方法主要对所有子序列采用同质化的建模策略，从而忽略了不同分量中固有的不同归纳偏置。我们发现趋势分量在通道间表现出显著的空间耦合，但带有明显的时间冗余；而季节性分量的特征是局部时间演化，但容易受到注意力干扰。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的解耦架构，为每个分量量身定制特定的建模策略以契合其内在属性。对于趋势分支，我们设计了潜在图块，采用潜在图建模来捕获全局拓扑依赖关系和系统级的协同运动。相反，对于季节分支，我们引入了高斯多尺度注意力……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出DST-Net解耦时空网络，摒弃对分解后各分量的同质化建模，针对趋势分量设计潜在图块以捕获全局拓扑依赖与协同运动，针对季节分量设计高斯多尺度注意力机制以聚焦局部时间演化。
en_tdlr: Proposes DST-Net, a disentangled spatio-temporal network that replaces homogeneous modeling of decomposed subsequences with tailored strategies, using a Latent Graph Block for the trend component to capture global topological dependencies and a Gaussian Multi-scale Attention mechanism for the seasonal component to focus on local temporal evolution.
